content.title: Arvada Mayors from 1904 Incorporation to Present
content.summary: Arvada has had a series of mayors since its incorporation in 1904, with Lauren Simpson currently serving from November 7, 2023. The mayors have included notable figures such as Marc Williams, who served from 2011 to 2023, and Robert Frie, who held the position multiple times between 1981 and 2011. The list highlights the city's leadership changes over the years, reflecting its governance history.
